provenance: Cumulative frames_recorded returned by the interactive controller after each selected action batch; final total from stop-result.json. These are chapter boundaries for this recording, not per-action replay timings.

chapters.caption: Open a terminal in the fresh capsule. The outside launcher already has explicit GitHub SSH authorization.
Zero SSH files. No SSH agent. The capsule connects to the host-owned proxy socket.
A real GitHub SSH clone succeeds. The private key stays on the host.
Point just this command at a missing proxy socket: the GitHub read fails.
The failed read exited 128. Using the normal proxy again returns GitHub HEAD successfully.
The recorded commands and independent checks agree: host identity, no copied key, working Git access.
